issues.description: Missing -o pipefail in set options. test.sh uses 'set -eu' but code_style rule 7 requires 'set -euo pipefail' for all shell scripts.

Test can produce false positive: if mg binary is not installed, 'mg -x' fails with 'command not found' which also triggers the else (pass) branch. The test cannot distinguish between 'binary exists and rejects invalid option' and 'binary does not exist at all'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add an explicit existence check before the if block, e.g.: 'command -v mg >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[fail] mg binary not found in PATH"; exit 1; }'

issues.description: Status inconsistency: notes.md header says '状态: published' but manifest.yaml says 'status: built'. The G4 verification section also shows 'status: published'. Only the footer correctly says '最终状态: built'. This is misleading as 'published' implies CI upload success while 'built' means verified but not uploaded.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update notes.md header and G4 section to say 'built' instead of 'published' to match manifest.yaml.

issues.description: Stale patch references in notes.md throughout multiple sections. References '0000-compat.h.patch' (does not exist) and '0002-cdbr.c.patch' (actual file is 0001-cdbr.c.patch). The compat.h header is created by 0002-configure.patch, not a separate 0000 patch. The delivery table lists '0000-compat.h.patch' and '0002-cdbr.c.patch' which don't exist. The source modification table says 'cdbr.c | 0002-cdbr.c.patch' but should be '0001-cdbr.c.patch'. The G4 section lists '0000-compat.h.patch, 0002-cdbr.c.patch' in ls patches/ output. None of these match the actual patch files.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update all patch references in notes.md to match actual file names: 0001-cdbr.c.patch, 0002-configure.patch, 0003-fileio.c.patch, 0004-mi_vector_hash.c.patch, 0005-term_private.h.patch. Remove all references to non-existent 0000-compat.h.patch. Update delivery table and source modification table accordingly.

issues.description: Redundant configure_args: generate() appends '--with-builtin-curses' to tc.configure_args, but build() manually runs './configure --with-builtin-curses' via self.run() without using Autotools(self).configure(). The configure_args set in generate() are never actually consumed because build() bypasses the Autotools helper.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either remove the redundant tc.configure_args.append('--with-builtin-curses') in generate(), or refactor build() to use Autotools(self).configure() and Autotools(self).make() to properly utilize the toolchain's configure_args.

issues.description: Non-standard output marker: test.sh uses '[test]' prefix instead of the standard '[step]'/'[ok]'/'[fail]' markers defined in code_style rule 9.
issues.fix_suggestion: Use '[step]' for the test step header, '[ok]' for success output (with 8-space indentation), and '[fail]' for failure output, as specified in rule 9.

summary: Re-audit of mg 7.3 Conan recipe after 5 P1 fixes. All 5 previous P1 issues are correctly resolved and verified: (1) conandata.yml URL uses official GitHub URL only (https://github.com/ibara/mg/releases/download/mg-7.3/mg-7.3.tar.gz) with no mirror prefix; (2) conanfile.py url field is set to the official URL (not a template placeholder); (3) manifest.yaml sha256 is filled with valid 64-char hash '1fd52feed9a96b93ef16c28ec4ff6cb25af85542ec949867bffaddee203d1e95'; (4) manifest.yaml patches_applied list correctly references all 5 actual patch files (0001-cdbr.c.patch through 0005-term_private.h.patch); (5) manifest.yaml patch_generation section has no hardcoded paths. No P0 deception issues found: test.sh runs the mg binary (R34 satisfied), sha256 is valid and non-forged, no stub patches (compat.h has real byte-order conversion logic with #ifdef __OHOS__ guard), manifest status 'built' is legitimate. No P1 recipe correctness issues found: no hardcoded paths, proper platform guards (#if defined(__linux__) || defined(__OHOS__)), correct version '7.3', no template placeholders, Conan 2.x API used, package_type='application' correct, method order correct (export_sources → requirements → layout → source → generate → build → package → package_info), cpp_info.bindirs set. 4 P2 issues (missing pipefail, test false-positive risk, notes.md status inconsistency, notes.md stale patch references) and 2 P3 issues (redundant configure_args, non-standard output markers). Verdict: PASS with warnings.
